title: Proxy Auth Database Lookup Failure
summary: Proxy-authenticated users were only granted public-only access due to a bug in the authentication flow, resulting in restricted access to tools and endpoints.
root_cause: The authentication flow did not perform database lookups to determine team memberships or admin privileges for proxy-authenticated users.
resolution: Enhanced the proxy authentication path to perform database lookups and resolve team memberships using the same pattern as session token authentication.
impact_description: Platform admin users were unable to access admin endpoints, and all users had restricted access to tools and endpoints.
